The equation for the reaction between magnesium and aqueous copper(II) sulfate is shown.
Mg+CuSO4→Cu+MgSO4
Which statement is correct?
A
Copper ions are oxidised to copper metal during the reaction.
B
Copper is displaced because it is more reactive than magnesium.
C
The oxidation number of magnesium decreases during the reaction.
D
The reaction happens because magnesium has a greater tendency to form positive ions
than copper.

options.label: A
options.text: Copper ions are oxidised to copper metal during the reaction.

options.label: B
options.text: Copper is displaced because it is more reactive than magnesium.

options.label: C
options.text: The oxidation number of magnesium decreases during the reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction happens because magnesium has a greater tendency to form positive ions
